name: codeforge-observability
description: Observe and control a CodeForge runtime from VS Code.

codeforge.runtimePath.description: Absolute path to a built runtime-cli.js. Required for 'Start Runtime Here' when the extension is installed as a .vsix (in a dev checkout the opened workspace is used).

codeforge.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js binary used to run the runtime. Leave empty to use 'node' from PATH. Must be the SYSTEM Node the runtime's native modules (better-sqlite3) were built for — do NOT point at VS Code itself.

codeforge.model.description: Default model id the runtime runs when started here. For cloud providers use their model id (e.g. 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile' for Groq, 'deepseek-chat' for DeepSeek).

enumDescriptions: Local Ollama server (default). No API key needed.
Any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenRouter, Groq, Cerebras, DeepSeek, Together, SambaNova, Mistral, xAI, LM Studio, and many more.
Google Gemini (AI Studio native API). Requires a Google AI Studio API key.
codeforge.provider.description: LLM provider to use when starting the runtime. 'ollama' for local models, 'openai-compatible' for cloud APIs (OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, etc.), 'gemini' for Google Generative Language API.

enumDescriptions: Groq (LPU inference, very fast, free tier) — https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
OpenRouter (200+ models, free models available) — https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
Google Gemini (AI Studio native) — uses gemini provider, not openai-compatible
codeforge.providerPreset.description: Choose a well-known provider to auto-fill the endpoint. Set to '' to use codeforge.endpoint directly. After selecting a preset, copy your API key into codeforge.apiKey.

codeforge.endpoint.description: API endpoint URL for the selected provider. Leave empty to use the provider default (Ollama: http://localhost:11434; Gemini: official endpoint). For openai-compatible providers this must be the base URL ending in /v1, e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. Auto-filled when codeforge.providerPreset is set.

codeforge.apiKey.description: Legacy: API key stored in settings (plain text). Prefer using 'CodeForge: Select Provider' which stores the key in VS Code SecretStorage (encrypted, not visible in settings files or git). This field is still read as a fallback if no secret is stored.

codeforge.port.description: HTTP port the runtime's observability server listens on.

codeforge.clarify.description: Ask clarifying questions in the Goals panel when a goal is ambiguous (starts the runtime with --mission on --clarify on).

codeforge.planOptions.description: Offer 2-4 approaches (with pros and cons) in the Goals panel for goals of medium or higher complexity, and plan with the one you pick (starts the runtime with --mission on --plan-options on).
